label: On the shared reflexive duplicate-label model, every world has fixed-language MC but no world has…
meaning: Issue #264 stipulated T-frame mathematics, not a source reading, refutation of Hume or Catholic-case frontier closure. Compose the existing K duplicate-language proofs, enumerate the two labels under the full-predicate successor-identity theorem, and use reflexivity to rule out necessary full collapse. Reuse the independently proved failure of language world extensionality.
